title: Polymorphic simulation of two shapes
statement: Define a Shape class with an Area method that returns 0.0, and two classes that extend it and override Area: Square (with a side) and Circle (with a radius, area = radius squared times 3.14). Store one of each in an array of Shape, traverse the array summing each area and write the total.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with classes.
The statement asks you to store the shapes in an array.
